raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 성인 대상 동네 건축 사진전과 공간 해설 행사를 안내해줘. 처음 오는 주민도 편하게 참여할 수 있고 건축과 빛을 관찰하는 즐거움이 느껴지게 해줘. 생활문화공간과 커뮤니티 디지털 화면에 쓰는 16:9 가로형으로 서로 다른 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 건축 공간의 빛과 형태를 보는 사진전, 함께 듣는 공간 이야기가 하나의 행사로 연결되어 보이고 일정·장소·입장·신청·방문 안내가 읽혀야 해. 특정 실존 건물이나 기관의 홍보물로 보이지 않도록 해줘. 단색 또는 유사 단색 배경에 큰 고딕 제목·날짜·안내문을 올리고 사진을 작은 칸이나 아래 띠로 붙이는 전체 구성은 제외해줘. 색을 나누거나 얇은 질감·그라데이션을 더하거나 글꼴만 바꾸어 같은 템플릿을 유지하지 말고, 이미지·시점·크롭·공간·글자·정보의 관계부터 서로 다른 전체 스타일로 설계해줘. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.

Every call returned the exact image for visual inspection. Only after M5 thumbnail320 had been displayed did I begin the first copy-reading/transcription stage, then judgments and scores. First readings were taken from the already displayed native pixels with the completed usage/thumbnail views available to assess layout and readability. All 55 first readings are retained; no ambiguity-triggered revisit was needed and no further poster opens were made. All views are available and correctly bound; usage views are 720×405 and thumbnails 320×180. The native ratios pass the declared 0.5-pixel single-edge rounding policy, not mathematical equality. I did not generate/edit images, inspect peer reviews, spawn/resume/fork, or claim a tool event or runtime session identity from filenames or helper success.

typography.location: left information and lower-right visitor guidance

space.location: stair diagonal, teal section edge and negative space around the cutaway

image_material.location: photo-frame edges, track lights, visitors and cut-section surfaces

evidence.location: diagonal daylight traveling from right opening across center wall and floor
evidence.observation: A substantial spatial light construction grounds the image in architectural observation and organizes the whole poster.

content_form.location: large light path and architectural opening relationships

hierarchy.location: central title versus left/right practical groups
hierarchy.observation: The centered dark title remains immediately recognizable in the bright light shape, while supporting copy is placed on darker side planes. The main light path reinforces the focal hierarchy.

typography.location: serif headline and angled English/upper-right practical lines

typography.location: left schedule, lower-left admission and lower-right guidance
typography.observation: The glyph sizes and dark/light contrasts remain readable across all practical entries, with no collisions at wall edges.

space.location: central lit wall, purple columns and triangular light on floor
space.observation: The title is held in a deliberate bright central proportion; side blocks and lower corner groups balance it. Negative areas remain architectural planes connected by the large diagonal light shape.

image_material.location: window reveals, coral wall grain and purple floor
image_material.observation: The stylized rendered material is consistent across walls and floor, aperture thickness is convincing, and the strong sunlight has a coherent geometric path. It is judged as expressive construction rather than against a photograph-only standard.

emotion_control.location: coral-purple room and warm bright central light
emotion_control.observation: The saturated colors communicate upbeat curiosity while maintaining clear adult practical copy. The warm light and welcoming footer keep the tone approachable.

ai_slop.location: right window, left opening and light/edge contacts
ai_slop.observation: Major edges, opening thickness and shadow/light shapes are coherent; there are no arbitrary ornamental objects, pseudo-labels or visibly broken architectural contacts.

residuals: The exhibition and space discussion are communicated principally through the descriptor; the scene is an empty architecture/light construction.
Text on wall planes and floor repeats the organizational idea of M1/M2 despite the expressive material and palette.
The local finish is strong, but the full-five diversity/style failure remains.

evidence.location: exhibition visitors and seated group
evidence.observation: Architecture photographs, standing observers, talking adults, windows, plants, benches and foreground participants make a substantial event scene independent of lettering.

evidence.location: gallery activity between the foreground figures
evidence.observation: Photo observation and conversation remain visually distinguishable, with daylight connecting the exhibited architectural views to the actual gathering space. Nonglyph content is the dominant scene, not a token ornament.

content_form.location: gallery wall and seated conversation
content_form.observation: The image directly depicts both supplied event functions in one sunlit room. Foreground participants make the viewer feel like an arriving resident rather than an outside architectural observer.

hierarchy.location: central lower title versus small left guidance
hierarchy.observation: The title and event category are a strong lower-center anchor, and upper schedule/benefits are readable. The visitor guidance is a much smaller detached pair on the floor to the left and is visually demoted despite being an explicit practical requirement.

hierarchy.location: foreground framing and low title
hierarchy.observation: The human framing and title survive, but the guidance has virtually no reading presence; the weak use-size priority is not repaired by the large headline.

typography.observation: The native Hangul and English are complete and generally clean, with intact word spaces and punctuation.
Korean letterforms are squeezed into roughly 8–9-pixel text. The complete native transcription cannot make the visit instruction and reassurance reliably readable at the specified use view.

space.location: foreground silhouettes and sunlit floor
space.observation: Large cropped participants establish an entrance frame, while the gallery occupies the middle ground and the broad lit floor accommodates the centered title. The photograph has a purposeful foreground/middle/background relationship.

image_material.location: gallery prints, wood seating and people
image_material.observation: The architectural views remain legible as photographs, the wooden seats and windows have readable local detail, and adults have coherent poses that distinguish observing from conversation. Foreground softness supports the close viewpoint.

emotion_control.location: mixed standing and seated adults
emotion_control.observation: Ordinary clothing, informal seating, conversational gestures and daylight communicate an accessible adult gathering. The scene provides a concrete social welcome even though its written reassurance is undersized.

ai_slop.observation: People are organized around the photographs and conversation; plants, stools and windows have a visible role in the space. No arbitrary decorative filler or pseudo-lettering is apparent. The repeated warm gallery motif across the set is a breadth residual rather than a claimed local anatomy defect.

residuals: Usage720 readability fails for the lower-left shoe/visit instruction and reassurance. Both are complete at native resolution; they have not been guessed as missing text.
Hierarchy and typography score 3 retain the small-information weakness even though the large scene and title are resolved.

M3 and M5 share four framed architectural views, a tree/plant-filled gallery, observers and a discussion group. The close human entrance framing and floor-title relationship distinguish M5, but this repeated content limits diversity refinement.
Native is 1672×940, which is 0.5 pixel below the exact 16:9 height. Ratio PASS uses the declared nearest-integer-single-edge exception.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: A close dark-blue foreground wall carries the large lower-left serif title; the image opens into a receding empty room with information on the far wall and guidance on the floor. This single-space asymmetric foreground/background organization differs from the central constructions of M2 and M4 and the populated gallery structures of M3 and M5.

evidence.location: central shaft and paired architectural crops
evidence.observation: Two large architectural crops meet around a pale vertical title shaft; portals and skylight create different axes, while practical groups occupy four separated planes. This is an edited viewpoint/crop relationship rather than recoloring M1, even though both use naturalistic empty interiors.

evidence.location: diagonal section contour and surrounding pale margins
evidence.observation: A cutaway stair and teal section edge expose the gallery as a large spatial illustration, with picture viewers and a talking group. Category/details are outside the left contour, name is upper right, and welcome is below the platform. This scene/margin relationship is unique in the set and differs from M5 eye-level human framing.

evidence.location: central illuminated wall, beam and side planes
evidence.observation: A frontal wall and diagonal light wedge make a central title stage; OPEN HOUSE follows a receding beam and side planes carry separated information. Its color and material differ, but the substantive distinction is centralized light/type staging and the architectural orientation compared with M1 lower-left foreground title or M2 narrow montage shaft.

evidence.location: near foreground participants, middle gallery and low floor title
evidence.observation: Large cropped people frame an arriving viewer, gallery viewing and a seated conversation occupy the middle, and the name is centered on the low sunlit floor. This foreground/middle/background participation viewpoint changes image and title roles from M3 diagram-like cutaway and from the three empty-room posters.

evidence.location: relationship to M3 and M1/M4
evidence.observation: M3 and M5 both use framed architectural views, plants, observers and a discussion group; M1 and M4 both place a serif title in an empty room. Those recurring subjects and wall/floor copy devices restrain exceptional breadth, but the changed viewpoints, cuts, scene silhouettes and title/information relationships support a strong, rather than exceptional, diversity score.

residuals: The set is structurally varied, but warm daylight, architectural interiors, planar black/ivory copy groups and plant shadows recur. Diversity is 4, not exceptional refinement, and is not inferred solely from photographic/illustrated/colored material labels.
M2 has a low hierarchy score, and M5 has low hierarchy/typography scores and a literal usage-readability failure. No set-level diversity value or average cancels those retained records.

Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.

content_form.location: gallery wall and seated conversation
content_form.observation: The image directly depicts both supplied event functions in one sunlit room. Foreground participants make the viewer feel like an arriving resident rather than an outside architectural observer.

hierarchy.observation: The human framing and title survive, but the guidance has virtually no reading presence; the weak use-size priority is not repaired by the large headline.

Korean letterforms are squeezed into roughly 8–9-pixel text. The complete native transcription cannot make the visit instruction and reassurance reliably readable at the specified use view.

space.location: foreground silhouettes and sunlit floor
space.observation: Large cropped participants establish an entrance frame, while the gallery occupies the middle ground and the broad lit floor accommodates the centered title. The photograph has a purposeful foreground/middle/background relationship.

image_material.location: gallery prints, wood seating and people
image_material.observation: The architectural views remain legible as photographs, the wooden seats and windows have readable local detail, and adults have coherent poses that distinguish observing from conversation. Foreground softness supports the close viewpoint.

emotion_control.location: mixed standing and seated adults
emotion_control.observation: Ordinary clothing, informal seating, conversational gestures and daylight communicate an accessible adult gathering. The scene provides a concrete social welcome even though its written reassurance is undersized.

ai_slop.observation: People are organized around the photographs and conversation; plants, stools and windows have a visible role in the space. No arbitrary decorative filler or pseudo-lettering is apparent. The repeated warm gallery motif across the set is a breadth residual rather than a claimed local anatomy defect.
